observations.voices_and_agency: Neet actively demands directions, invades the shower boundary, appropriates a towel and hides olives. Buddy chooses the seat facing away from food, remains awake to make Neet back away, offers the other chair with a delayed silence condition, then attempts another nap. His comfort motive and decisions therefore affect action rather than merely supply commentary. Heather removes Neet from the counter, enforces the closed outer door, frees his paw and returns the towel; her practical affection remains distinct. Historical Heather-and-two-dogs household is retained.
observations.cause_effect_and_payoff: Directions lead to lounge, lounge amenities split their priorities, interrupted rest motivates Buddy's redirection and second nap, that nap enables concealment, and the boarding announcement causes the reveal before the explicit bag transfer. The group reaches departure together and the final boast pays off Neet's opening confidence; later travel consequences are not falsely resolved here.
